# Alin Sever – Data Analyst & MSc in Data Science and AI

Welcome to my professional portfolio.  


This website showcases selected analytical, machine learning, and data science projects developed during my MSc in Applied Information and Data Science at the Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and through independent work.

My interests focus on building practical **AI solutions**, **automation workflows**, dashboards, and **data-driven tools** that solve real business problems and improve decision-making.


The portfolio is divided into two main sections:

- **ML Portfolio** - with selected projects shared through GitHub repositories for easier access to the code and project structure.


- **Standalone Projects** -  applied analysis, dashboards, data pipelines, and research projects

Use the sidebar to navigate through the content.
